subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Series Circuits: One Path Only
description: A fast breakdown of Series Circuits: One Path Only for builders.

hook.text: Old Christmas lights had one fatal flaw — one bulb dies, they all go dark.

buildup.text: In a series circuit, components line up end to end. Current has only one path.

discovery.text: The same current flows through every component. Resistances add up directly.

twist.text: Voltage splits across each resistor — more resistance gets more voltage.

climax.text: Break any link and the entire circuit stops. That's the weakness of series.

punchline.text: One path, one current — and one point of failure.

quiz.question: What happens to total resistance in a series circuit?
options: It equals the smallest resistor value
Individual resistances add up to give the total
It equals the average of all resistors
